gpu_tip: ~106GB total at 128K context — the full-precision build, and with all 64 of K2 Horizon's layers on full attention the f16 KV cache alone is ~34GB at that length. It is a dense model, so every layer that spills to system RAM costs real speed: a 24GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4090) plus a 96GB DDR5 kit runs it via llama.cpp's layer offloading, but slowly. The quantized builds below are the practical choice.
mac_tip: Needs ~106GB — fits a 128GB MacBook Pro (M4 Max or M5 Max), with little to spare; no smaller config fits.
